caption: The drawing is on a light beige background and consists of fine, precise pencil lines outlining components of a wooden furniture piece, likely a bed or similar structure. At the top left and right are two pairs of vertical, spindle-shaped objects with twisted detailing and blocky sections at their top and bottom, annotated with measurements. Between them, near the upper center, there are side profiles and sectional views of a turned baluster and some blocky shapes that appear to represent parts of a structural frame. Below these, at the center, is a horizontal side view of a rail or stretcher with gentle curves, again annotated with length and height dimensions. At the bottom is a corresponding, longer horizontal view of the full-length piece, segmented and marked with various measurements. The entire composition consists of orthogonal projections and profile views, arranged to display the parts’ dimensions and construction details, with all lines and notes in a faint grey tone matching the pencil medium. There are no colors present apart from the beige of the paper and the grey of the pencil.
title: Chair
